from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference-3/play/users/u044/system/state/workspace/programs/task-3ef8eba3.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    # The missing rectangular patch is restored by reflecting the cells above/below
    # the horizontal center line of the 24x24 pattern.
    zeros = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 0]
    if not zeros:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in zeros), max(r for r, c in zeros)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    return [[grid[len(grid)-1-r][c] for c in range(c0, c1+1)] for r in range(r0, r1+1)]
'''
p.write_text(code)
print(p)
